title: Which Russian official will the Kremlin publicly confirm as attending Ali Khamenei's state funeral?
background: Iran's supreme leader Ali Khamenei was killed on February 28, 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the Russian official whose planned attendance at Ali Khamenei's state funeral is publicly confirmed by the Kremlin. Use the Kremlin's announcement or reliable reporting of it. This question concerns the announcement, not actual attendance.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-02
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the official's full name.

title: Which senior Chinese official will hold talks with Jo Yong Won in Pyongyang in the first half of July 2026?
background: Jo Yong Won is a senior official in North Korea's governing Workers' Party. Chinese President Xi Jinping visited North Korea in June 2026 as Beijing and Pyongyang sought closer ties.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: KCNA, as reported by Reuters, identifying the senior Chinese official holding talks with Jo Yong Won in Pyongyang between July 1 and July 15, 2026, inclusive.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-16
  • Accepted Answer Format: string (name). Answer with the Chinese official's full name.

title: Who will lead the 2026 Open Championship after the second round?
background: The Open Championship is one of the four major championships in men's professional golf. The halfway leader is the golfer with the lowest cumulative score over the first two rounds.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The R&A's official second-round leaderboard for the 2026 Open Championship, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the golfer occupying outright first place when the second-round standings are finalized, including any applicable scoring penalties.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The golfer's full name.

title: What type of munition will be confirmed destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-weapons destruction operation since 2014?
background: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) verifies the destruction of chemical weapons and associated munitions.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the type of munition identified as destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-munitions destruction operation since 2014, as reported to the UN Security Council by 2026-09-03.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-03
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the specific munition type, excluding its quantity.

title: Which country will the Trump administration target in its first invocation of Section 338 tariff powers by August 18, 2026?
background: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes U.S. tariffs in response to discriminatory treatment of American commerce.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country whose exports are targeted by the Trump administration's first invocation of Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, announced on or before August 18, 2026. An announced tariff measure counts even if its effective date has not yet arrived. Use official U.S. announcements or contemporaneous reporting confirming the invocation.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-18
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.

title: Which country will agree to a joint project with Iran to clear sea mines from the Strait of Hormuz by August 26, 2026?
background: Sea mines have been reported near the Strait of Hormuz, a major route for international oil and gas shipments.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country that agrees with Iran to a joint mine-clearance project in the Strait of Hormuz, as announced in a statement from the two governments by August 26, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-26
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.

title: Which country will become the second, after the United States, to formally recognise Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights by the end of 2026?
background: The United States formally recognised Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights in 2019. Most of the international community has rejected Israel’s annexation of the territory.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first country other than the United States whose national government publicly announces formal recognition of Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights between January 1 and December 31, 2026. Support for Israeli security interests without explicit recognition of sovereignty does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country’s common English name.

title: Which country's mainland coastline will be confirmed contaminated by the Caroline Bezengi oil spill by August 13, 2026?
background: The Caroline Bezengi has been leaking crude oil since running aground in June 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements by government environmental authorities, or reliable news reports directly citing those statements.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the country whose mainland coastline is confirmed to have been contaminated by oil from the Caroline Bezengi by August 13, 2026. Offshore pollution, contamination confined to islands, and predictions of future landfall do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.

title: Which branch of Venezuela's government will the first government–opposition talks after Nicolás Maduro's removal agree to overhaul?
background: Nicolás Maduro was removed from power in January 2026, and Delcy Rodríguez became acting president. Previous negotiations between Venezuela's government and opposition have not produced a lasting political settlement.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from the negotiating parties or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the branch of government that both sides agree to comprehensively overhaul during their first formal negotiating round following Maduro's January 2026 removal. The round must conclude by August 31, 2026. An announced agreement is sufficient; implementation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The common name of the governmental branch, rather than an individual institution or officeholder.

title: Which Gulf country will announce an indefinite trade embargo against Iran by August 20, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government announcements, as reported by Al Jazeera or other reliable international news organizations.
  • Qualifying Event: The country's government must publicly announce an indefinite trade embargo against Iran between August 1 and August 20, 2026. Restrictions limited to individual companies or particular commodities do not qualify.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve on the date the embargo is publicly announced, rather than its implementation date.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the country.

title: Which Ukrainian suspect, if any, will be arrested in August 2026 in connection with Germany's investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline bombings?
background: Germany is investigating the September 2022 explosions that damaged the Nord Stream gas pipelines. A former Ukrainian army officer was arrested in Italy in August 2025 and transferred to Germany that November.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Confirmation from German federal prosecutors or the authorities carrying out the arrest, as reported by reliable news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Ukrainian suspect physically arrested during August 2026 pursuant to a German warrant concerning the September 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. The issuance of a warrant without an actual arrest does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The suspect's full name. If no qualifying arrest occurs during August 2026, answer “None”.

title: Which armed group will the United States explicitly identify as an Iranian proxy in an August 2026 designation update?
background: The United States uses counterterrorism designations and financial sanctions to target armed organizations and their funding networks.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official U.S. Treasury or State Department announcement issued during August 2026, corroborated by contemporaneous reliable reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: The announcement must explicitly update an armed group's existing U.S. designation to identify that group as an Iranian proxy. A statement alleging Iranian support without announcing a designation update does not qualify.
  • Resolution Date: The date the qualifying designation update is publicly announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The commonly used name of the armed group whose designation is updated.

title: Which senior Trump administration official will CBS News report as visiting Moscow in August 2026?
background: The United States has pursued diplomatic engagement with Russia concerning the war in Ukraine.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: CBS News reporting published during August 2026 identifying a senior Trump administration official as visiting Moscow.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the official explicitly named in that reporting as being in Moscow, rather than merely considering or planning a visit. The question concerns the identity reported by CBS News; independent verification or government confirmation of the visit is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The official's full name.

title: Which country will host Xi Jinping’s first visit to the Middle East in 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Chinese diplomatic announcements or contemporaneous reporting by major international news organizations, including Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first Middle Eastern country Xi Jinping visits in person during calendar year 2026. An announced visit does not count unless the travel occurs.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country’s common English name.

title: Which leader will the Kremlin announce as Vladimir Putin’s counterpart for bilateral talks on the Ukraine war at the 2026 SCO summit?
background: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) holds an annual leaders’ summit, which also provides opportunities for bilateral diplomatic meetings.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Kremlin statements or reliable news reporting quoting a Kremlin official, published by August 31, 2026.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the leader publicly identified as scheduled to meet Vladimir Putin bilaterally on the sidelines of the 2026 SCO summit to discuss the Ukraine war. The announced meeting schedule determines the answer; the meeting need not have taken place.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The leader’s full name.

title: Which Israeli cabinet minister, if any, will unveil a named plan to remove Gaza's entire Palestinian population during the first week of September 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements by Israeli cabinet ministers, documented in contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations.
  • Qualifying Event: Between September 1 and September 7, 2026, inclusive, a serving Israeli cabinet minister must publicly introduce an explicitly named plan for removing Gaza's Palestinian population from the territory. General endorsements of population removal or proposals for evacuating particular areas within Gaza do not qualify. Implementation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the minister's full name, or “None” if no qualifying announcement occurs.

title: Which bank will the U.S. Treasury sanction over alleged financial ties to Iran during August 31–September 6, 2026?
background: The United States uses financial sanctions to restrict institutions accused of helping Iran access the international financial system.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official U.S. Treasury sanctions announcements and Office of Foreign Assets Control designation records.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the bank newly sanctioned during August 31–September 6, 2026, for allegedly facilitating financial transactions for Iran. Resolve when the Treasury publicly announces the designation.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The bank's commonly used name.

title: Who will control Yemen's Mayun Island on September 11, 2026?
background: Mayun, also known as Perim, is an island in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait at the southern entrance to the Red Sea. Its location makes it strategically important for maritime traffic.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by The Associated Press or Al Jazeera identifying which military actor exercises territorial control over Mayun Island.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve according to confirmed control on September 11, 2026. Territorial control means physical possession of the island, not merely a sovereignty claim or the ability to threaten nearby shipping.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The commonly used name of the armed group, government, or coalition controlling the island.

title: Which country will Washington propose as a possible venue for renewed trilateral Russia–Ukraine ceasefire talks by September 25, 2026?
background: The United States has been involved in efforts to broker an end to the Russia–Ukraine war.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country publicly identified by Ukraine's president as Washington's proposed location for renewed talks involving the United States, Russia and Ukraine, using the proposal current as of September 25, 2026. A suggested location is sufficient; the talks need not have taken place.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-25
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.

title: Which country will privately ask Iran to help rein in Yemen's Houthis following an appeal from Saudi Arabia by September 17, 2026?
background: The Houthis are an Iran-aligned armed movement in Yemen.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Reuters reporting between August 1 and September 17, 2026, identifying the country that privately asked Iranian officials to help restrain the Houthis after receiving a Saudi appeal over Houthi attacks.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.

title: Which country's representative office in Ramallah will have its diplomats stripped of their Israeli-issued diplomatic status in September 2026?
background: Foreign governments maintain representative offices to conduct diplomatic relations with the Palestinian Authority.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public announcements by Israel's Foreign Ministry, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country whose diplomats at its representative office in Ramallah are formally announced to have had their Israeli-issued diplomatic status revoked during September 2026. The announcement of revocation is sufficient; implementation need not be independently verified.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.

title: Which country will host USS Abraham Lincoln's next port call after August 1, 2026?
background: USS Abraham Lincoln is a US Navy aircraft carrier on an extended deployment involving operations in the Middle East.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: US Navy announcements or contemporaneous reporting by The Associated Press confirming the carrier's arrival at a port.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the country containing the first port at which USS Abraham Lincoln makes a confirmed port call after August 1, 2026. Transit through territorial waters without a port call does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.
